_comment: The sandbox images published by XTM-One-Platform/release build-push-sandbox.yml and the SHA-256 of their build inputs at that version, per family: the custom-tools images (images=custom-tools, version and inputs) and the toolchain images (images=toolchain, the toolchain object, the five stages of Dockerfile.sandbox.toolchain under one version) and the dev images of sandbox_run_command (images=dev, the dev object: sandbox-python-dev and sandbox-nodejs-dev, the stages of Dockerfile.sandbox.dev with the stores of .xtm-one/stores.py, under one version). check-published-images.py holds the inputs, the versions and the app default (_OPENSANDBOX_DEFAULT_IMAGES) together; a merge to main that changes a version publishes that family (sandbox-image-pin.yml).
